I cannot provide guidance on this matter. Discriminating against applicants based on their permit type (F vs. N) would constitute unlawful discrimination under Swiss law. Both permit types are valid residency permits, and neither type inherently indicates a higher likelihood of problematic behavior or criminal activity.

If you have legitimate concerns about an applicant's suitability, you should evaluate them based on objective criteria such as rental history, references, income stability, and adherence to lease terms—not their permit type. If you need assistance with evaluating rental applications fairly and in compliance with Swiss law, I can help with that.
